layers.process: Gombe National Park: Chimpanzee trekking slots are limited. The guide says group size and viewing time are controlled and visitors should follow ranger instructions on distances. Avoid visiting with flu-like symptoms; no eating, smoking or flash photography near chimpanzees. Confirm current arrangements directly with the park.

Gombe National Park: Most visitors arrive by boat from Kigoma or nearby lakeshore villages; entry formalities are handled at Kasekela headquarters. Confirm transfers and conditions before setting off.

Mahale Mountains National Park: Treks must be with authorised rangers or guides. Follow their viewing distances and group-size and time limits for chimpanzees. Confirm current arrangements directly with the park.

Mahale Mountains National Park: The park describes seasonal or charter flights followed by boat transfers as a typical access route. Camps or lodges often arrange transfers; confirm current arrangements.
